brief:
Boycott campaigns against Israeli products and companies accused of links to the occupation are expanding across Britain, Shehab Wire reported. The grassroots movements have mounted protest actions at retail locations, targeting stores that stock goods identified as connected to Israeli settlements and military operations.

The campaigns reflect growing activism in Britain around Palestinian issues, with consumers and organizers mobilizing to pressure commercial establishments over their supply chains and corporate partnerships. Demonstrators have focused particular attention on major multinational corporations, including beverage manufacturer Coca-Cola, which activists claim maintains business relationships with Israeli entities. The boycott efforts represent part of broader international pressure campaigns seeking to leverage consumer choices as a tool for political change.
